documents.title: / — configuration field
documents.summary: The complete versioned policy combines declared sources, workloads and optional grants, listener, repository and operational settings. Validate it as one candidate; a schema-valid field does not grant runtime authority.

documents.title: /version — configuration field
documents.summary: Policy contract version; the supported declaration is the integer 1, not a package or MCP protocol version.

documents.title: /sources — configuration field
documents.summary: Source ID to source declaration. IDs use lowercase letters/digits, `_` or `-`, start alphanumeric, and are at most 64 characters.

documents.title: /sources/{id} — configuration field
documents.summary: One source ID and adapter declaration. Only the chosen adapter’s permitted selector/identity fields are accepted; credentials remain separately protected references.

documents.title: /sources/{id}/type — configuration field
documents.summary: One of the source types above.

documents.title: /sources/{id}/endpoint — configuration field
documents.summary: HTTPS only, host required, no userinfo/query/fragment.

documents.title: /sources/{id}/account — configuration field
documents.summary: Exact cloud account or Azure tenant selector; it is not an interactive account choice.

documents.title: /sources/{id}/region — configuration field
documents.summary: Exact AWS region.

documents.title: /sources/{id}/project — configuration field
documents.summary: Exact project, including Bitwarden's expected project ID or 1Password vault name.

documents.title: /sources/{id}/environment — configuration field
documents.summary: Exact provider environment. For 1Password it is rejected because Environments are unsupported.

documents.title: /sources/{id}/namespace — configuration field
documents.summary: Declared namespace selector.

documents.title: /sources/{id}/mount — configuration field
documents.summary: Exact KV v2 mount selector.

documents.title: /sources/{id}/path — configuration field
documents.summary: Local data path or provider path selector. It contains no secret bytes.

documents.title: /sources/{id}/resources — configuration field
documents.summary: Exact permitted remote resource names. A binding must match one item exactly.

documents.title: /sources/{id}/resources/* — configuration field
documents.summary: One entry in this collection: Exact permitted remote resource names. A binding must match one item exactly.

documents.title: /sources/{id}/identity — configuration field
documents.summary: `""`, `none`, `token_file`, `workload`, `profile`, `environment`, `managed`, `ec2`, `ecs`, or `metadata`. Unsupported combinations fail; it does not enable broad fallback.

documents.title: /sources/{id}/token_file — configuration field
documents.summary: Reference to a protected bootstrap token; never put the token in policy.

documents.title: /sources/{id}/profile — configuration field
documents.summary: Declared identity selector, such as an Azure client ID; this is not a developer-profile fallback.

documents.title: /sources/{id}/sops — configuration field
documents.summary: Trusted SOPS executable path.

documents.title: /sources/{id}/age_identity_file — configuration field
documents.summary: Protected age identity-file reference. It must not collide with a configured source data path.

documents.title: /sources/{id}/vault_allowlist — configuration field
documents.summary: Explicit HTTPS Vault/OpenBao endpoint allowlist. It is invalid on other source types and cannot be combined with an age identity file.

documents.title: /sources/{id}/vault_allowlist/* — configuration field
documents.summary: One entry in this collection: Explicit HTTPS Vault/OpenBao endpoint allowlist. It is invalid on other source types and cannot be combined with an age identity file.

documents.title: /sources/{id}/vault_keys — configuration field
documents.summary: Exact Transit key scopes; required with the allowlist.

documents.title: /sources/{id}/vault_keys/* — configuration field
documents.summary: One entry in this collection: Exact Transit key scopes; required with the allowlist.

documents.title: /sources/{id}/audit_verified — configuration field
documents.summary: Operator declaration that the source's audit capability has been verified. `audit_required` workloads require it; the declaration is not proof by itself.

documents.title: /workloads — configuration field
documents.summary: Workload ID to workload declaration; IDs use the same rule as source IDs.

documents.title: /workloads/{id} — configuration field
documents.summary: One exact workload’s delivery mode, bindings and optional command/targets. All required bindings resolve before a generation is used.

documents.title: /workloads/{id}/mode — configuration field
documents.summary: `online` resolves fresh and cannot have a snapshot. `offline` uses only eligible local/static inputs and cannot set `audit_required`. `hybrid` may use an approved static snapshot only for qualifying unavailable failures. Denial, TLS/trust failure, malformed data, and expiry do not authorize fallback.

documents.title: /workloads/{id}/bindings — configuration field
documents.summary: Exact output declarations described below. All required bindings resolve before a generation is used.

documents.title: /workloads/{id}/bindings/* — configuration field
documents.summary: One entry in this collection: Exact output declarations described below. All required bindings resolve before a generation is used.

documents.title: /workloads/{id}/bindings/*/name — configuration field
documents.summary: Delivered environment/key name. It must be a unique valid environment name and cannot be a protected bootstrap name.

documents.title: /workloads/{id}/bindings/*/source — configuration field
documents.summary: Source ID in `sources`.

documents.title: /workloads/{id}/bindings/*/resource — configuration field
documents.summary: Exact permitted resource. No globs, traversal, backslashes, or wildcard syntax.

documents.title: /workloads/{id}/bindings/*/field — configuration field
documents.summary: Exact top-level string field selected from a structured provider value. Empty selects the complete string value.

documents.title: /workloads/{id}/bindings/*/version — configuration field
documents.summary: Exact supported provider version selector; unsupported source types fail validation.

documents.title: /workloads/{id}/bindings/*/allow_offline — configuration field
documents.summary: Required for every offline binding and for any value intended for an encrypted snapshot.

documents.title: /workloads/{id}/bindings/*/allow_publish — configuration field
documents.summary: Required for every binding when the workload defines any target. It grants no destination by itself.

documents.title: /workloads/{id}/environment — configuration field
documents.summary: Literal non-secret base environment. Names must be valid and cannot collide case-insensitively with bindings or protected bootstrap names.

documents.title: /workloads/{id}/environment/{id} — configuration field
documents.summary: One literal non-secret environment declaration under a valid environment name. No shell expansion or provider lookup is implied by its text.

documents.title: /workloads/{id}/command — configuration field
documents.summary: Absolute program and arguments for `run`; no shell evaluation. Empty is valid for projection-only policies.

documents.title: /workloads/{id}/command/* — configuration field
documents.summary: One entry in this collection: Absolute program and arguments for `run`; no shell evaluation. Empty is valid for projection-only policies.

documents.title: /workloads/{id}/command_sha256 — configuration field
documents.summary: Exact executable identity check for the declared command. A pinned workload rejects a different local command or argument vector; an identical override still verifies the digest. CLI `run` validates before workload state and secret resolution and repeats validation before launch; policy acquisition can precede it. The protected-file hash has a 128 MiB admission limit and bounded read, followed by identity/size/protection checks. Compute the digest from the installed reviewed executable; do not use a placeholder. MCP `run` requires a command and digest and uses the same identity validator. Pathname execution is not atomic; separate scripts, plugins and input files need their own integrity controls.

documents.title: /workloads/{id}/untrusted_code — configuration field
documents.summary: Records that the workload may execute untrusted code. It does not reduce authorization or create a sandbox. A Windows secret-bearing run requires this to be `false`.

documents.title: /workloads/{id}/directory — configuration field
documents.summary: Working directory for the declared command. A secret-bearing run requires a protected working directory, executable directory, and every directory searched through `PATH`.

documents.title: /workloads/{id}/snapshot — configuration field
documents.summary: Explicit encrypted offline/hybrid snapshot declaration below. `online` workloads cannot set `snapshot.path`.

documents.title: /workloads/{id}/snapshot/path — configuration field
documents.summary: Protected local encrypted snapshot destination/source.

documents.title: /workloads/{id}/snapshot/recipients — configuration field
documents.summary: Explicit age recipients for snapshot encryption. Required when creating a snapshot.

documents.title: /workloads/{id}/snapshot/recipients/* — configuration field
documents.summary: One entry in this collection: Explicit age recipients for snapshot encryption. Required when creating a snapshot.

documents.title: /workloads/{id}/snapshot/identity_file — configuration field
documents.summary: Protected age identity used to decrypt the snapshot.

documents.title: /workloads/{id}/snapshot/sops — configuration field
documents.summary: Trusted SOPS executable for snapshot operations.

documents.title: /workloads/{id}/targets — configuration field
documents.summary: Named one-way projection targets below. All bindings must set `allow_publish`, and each target must set `accept_snapshot: true`.

documents.title: /workloads/{id}/targets/{id} — configuration field
documents.summary: One explicit one-way static projection destination. Each binding must allow_publish and the target must acknowledge accept_snapshot; native activation is separately authorized.

documents.title: /workloads/{id}/targets/{id}/type — configuration field
documents.summary: Projection adapter. Platform and provider qualification remains separate.

documents.title: /workloads/{id}/targets/{id}/path — configuration field
documents.summary: Required absolute destination for `file`, `systemd`, and `windows`; optional destination binding name for Cloudflare/Netlify; rejected for Windmill.

documents.title: /workloads/{id}/targets/{id}/endpoint — configuration field
documents.summary: Required HTTPS Windmill endpoint; optional HTTPS Cloudflare/Netlify API override; no credentials in the URL.

documents.title: /workloads/{id}/targets/{id}/account — configuration field
documents.summary: Exact destination selectors; required combinations are listed below.

documents.title: /workloads/{id}/targets/{id}/project — configuration field
documents.summary: Exact destination selectors; required combinations are listed below.

documents.title: /workloads/{id}/targets/{id}/environment — configuration field
documents.summary: Exact destination selectors; required combinations are listed below.

documents.title: /workloads/{id}/targets/{id}/resource — configuration field
documents.summary: Exact destination selectors; required combinations are listed below.

documents.title: /workloads/{id}/targets/{id}/token_file — configuration field
documents.summary: Protected destination bootstrap credential reference for cloud publication.

documents.title: /workloads/{id}/targets/{id}/accept_snapshot — configuration field
documents.summary: Must be `true` for every target, acknowledging it receives a deployed static copy.

documents.title: /workloads/{id}/targets/{id}/service — configuration field
documents.summary: Native systemd/Windows service name, required when activation is `restart` or `reload`.

documents.title: /workloads/{id}/targets/{id}/activation — configuration field
documents.summary: `restart` requires `service`; `reload` is systemd-only. Omit activation and service together when no native action is required.

documents.title: /workloads/{id}/audit_required — configuration field
documents.summary: Requires every source used by the workload to declare `audit_verified`. It also forbids offline mode and snapshot export.

documents.title: /grants — configuration field
documents.summary: Exact local MCP authorization entries. Omitting the list grants nothing. Grants are additive, so a separate active grant may still authorize a request.

documents.title: /grants/* — configuration field
documents.summary: One grant binds an exact subject, workload and operations, with optional client/authority/key/time restrictions. It cannot issue an identity token or widen provider access.

documents.title: /grants/*/subject — configuration field
documents.summary: Exact kernel-derived local subject or issuer-qualified remote subject. A display name or USER variable is not identity evidence.

documents.title: /grants/*/client — configuration field
documents.summary: Exact client identifier. An empty client is local-only and does not match a hosted client; named-authority grants require a client.

documents.title: /grants/*/workload — configuration field
documents.summary: The exact declared workload ID governed by this grant.

documents.title: /grants/*/operations — configuration field
documents.summary: Permitted list/status/run/read operations. Run covers the enrolled workload; read additionally needs exact binding aliases.

documents.title: /grants/*/operations/* — configuration field
documents.summary: One entry in this collection: Permitted list/status/run/read operations. Run covers the enrolled workload; read additionally needs exact binding aliases.

documents.title: /grants/*/keys — configuration field
documents.summary: Exact declared binding aliases permitted for raw read. Keys do not narrow run and cannot expose bootstrap identities.

documents.title: /grants/*/keys/* — configuration field
documents.summary: One entry in this collection: Exact declared binding aliases permitted for raw read. Keys do not narrow run and cannot expose bootstrap identities.

documents.title: /grants/*/not_before — configuration field
documents.summary: Inclusive RFC3339 start of this local grant. It does not schedule work or replace token validation.

documents.title: /grants/*/expires_at — configuration field
documents.summary: Exclusive RFC3339 end of this local grant; it must follow not_before. It does not revoke already delivered material.

documents.title: /grants/*/authority — configuration field
documents.summary: Exact named MCP authority; unnamed local/single-issuer grants cannot be consumed through a named authority.

documents.title: /mcp — configuration field
documents.summary: MCP listener and trusted authorization-server declarations. It does not configure login or token issuance.

documents.title: /mcp/issuer — configuration field
documents.summary: Compact single-issuer alternative: all three are required together; `audience` is also the protected resource URL. Its scope names are `cq:mcp` plus `cq:list`, `cq:status`, `cq:run`, or `cq:read`. Prefer named authorities for custom audiences or roles.

documents.title: /mcp/audience — configuration field
documents.summary: Compact single-issuer alternative: all three are required together; `audience` is also the protected resource URL. Its scope names are `cq:mcp` plus `cq:list`, `cq:status`, `cq:run`, or `cq:read`. Prefer named authorities for custom audiences or roles.

documents.title: /mcp/jwks_url — configuration field
documents.summary: Compact single-issuer alternative: all three are required together; `audience` is also the protected resource URL. Its scope names are `cq:mcp` plus `cq:list`, `cq:status`, `cq:run`, or `cq:read`. Prefer named authorities for custom audiences or roles.

documents.title: /mcp/address — configuration field
documents.summary: Optional listener address. Bind and exposure decisions remain operator-controlled.

documents.title: /mcp/origins — configuration field
documents.summary: Request `Origin` allowlist for HTTP mode. It is an origin check, not a CORS implementation: this profile does not emit browser CORS permission headers.

documents.title: /mcp/origins/* — configuration field
documents.summary: One entry in this collection: Request `Origin` allowlist for HTTP mode. It is an origin check, not a CORS implementation: this profile does not emit browser CORS permission headers.

documents.title: /mcp/hosts — configuration field
documents.summary: Allowed Host values, without wildcard/URL syntax.

documents.title: /mcp/hosts/* — configuration field
documents.summary: One entry in this collection: Allowed Host values, without wildcard/URL syntax.

documents.title: /mcp/audit_path — configuration field
documents.summary: Protected local metadata-only audit receipt path.

documents.title: /mcp/resource — configuration field
documents.summary: Public MCP resource identifier with a non-root path, independent of the token audience. Used with `authorities`. Loopback HTTP is allowed for the local resource only.

documents.title: /mcp/authorities — configuration field
documents.summary: Explicit access-token issuers and permission mappings described below. Cannot be mixed with the single-issuer fields.

documents.title: /mcp/authorities/{id} — configuration field
documents.summary: One explicitly trusted access-token authority and its operation mapping; verify issuer/audience/client and exact local grants separately.

documents.title: /mcp/authorities/{id}/issuer — configuration field
documents.summary: Exact HTTPS issuer and same-origin public signing-key endpoint; no token-provided key locations or redirect discovery.

documents.title: /mcp/authorities/{id}/jwks_url — configuration field
documents.summary: Exact HTTPS issuer and same-origin public signing-key endpoint; no token-provided key locations or redirect discovery.

documents.title: /mcp/authorities/{id}/trust_store_file — configuration field
documents.summary: Optional pair for a private-CA issuer: canonical absolute protected PEM bundle and its 64-lowercase-hex SHA-256. When present, the bundle is the authority's complete replacement root store for JWKS retrieval; it does not append to system roots or affect another authority, provider, or CLI. Both fields are required together.

documents.title: /mcp/authorities/{id}/trust_store_sha256 — configuration field
documents.summary: Optional pair for a private-CA issuer: canonical absolute protected PEM bundle and its 64-lowercase-hex SHA-256. When present, the bundle is the authority's complete replacement root store for JWKS retrieval; it does not append to system roots or affect another authority, provider, or CLI. Both fields are required together.

documents.title: /mcp/authorities/{id}/audience — configuration field
documents.summary: Exact registered API identifier. It may differ from the public `resource` URL, including an Entra application GUID.

documents.title: /mcp/authorities/{id}/profile — configuration field
documents.summary: `rfc9068` for signed `at+jwt` access tokens, or `microsoft-entra-v2` for the explicit Entra v2 API-token profile. Both verify RS256/ES256 signatures, issuer, audience and time claims.

documents.title: /mcp/authorities/{id}/clients — configuration field
documents.summary: Optional exact allowlists. A principal must match one entry in each configured list. Empty lists leave that dimension to exact local grants.

documents.title: /mcp/authorities/{id}/clients/* — configuration field
documents.summary: One entry in this collection: Optional exact allowlists. A principal must match one entry in each configured list. Empty lists leave that dimension to exact local grants.

documents.title: /mcp/authorities/{id}/subjects — configuration field
documents.summary: Optional exact allowlists. A principal must match one entry in each configured list. Empty lists leave that dimension to exact local grants.

documents.title: /mcp/authorities/{id}/subjects/* — configuration field
documents.summary: One entry in this collection: Optional exact allowlists. A principal must match one entry in each configured list. Empty lists leave that dimension to exact local grants.

documents.title: /mcp/authorities/{id}/required_scopes — configuration field
documents.summary: Optional requirements on every accepted token: all listed scopes and all listed roles must be present.

documents.title: /mcp/authorities/{id}/required_scopes/* — configuration field
documents.summary: One entry in this collection: Optional requirements on every accepted token: all listed scopes and all listed roles must be present.

documents.title: /mcp/authorities/{id}/required_roles — configuration field
documents.summary: Optional requirements on every accepted token: all listed scopes and all listed roles must be present.

documents.title: /mcp/authorities/{id}/required_roles/* — configuration field
documents.summary: One entry in this collection: Optional requirements on every accepted token: all listed scopes and all listed roles must be present.

documents.title: /mcp/authorities/{id}/permissions — configuration field
documents.summary: Maps `list`, `status`, `run`, or `read` to `{ "scopes": [...], "roles": [...] }`. Every declared scope and role is required; an omitted operation or empty permission denies it.

documents.title: /mcp/authorities/{id}/permissions/{id} — configuration field
documents.summary: Requirements for one list/status/run/read operation: every declared scope and role must be present, plus a matching exact local grant. Missing or empty permission denies.

documents.title: /mcp/authorities/{id}/permissions/{id}/scopes — configuration field
documents.summary: All listed registered API scopes are required for this operation; role claims are checked separately.

documents.title: /mcp/authorities/{id}/permissions/{id}/scopes/* — configuration field
documents.summary: One entry in this collection: All listed registered API scopes are required for this operation; role claims are checked separately.

documents.title: /mcp/authorities/{id}/permissions/{id}/roles — configuration field
documents.summary: All listed API roles are required for this operation; scopes and roles are not flattened together.

documents.title: /mcp/authorities/{id}/permissions/{id}/roles/* — configuration field
documents.summary: One entry in this collection: All listed API roles are required for this operation; scopes and roles are not flattened together.

documents.title: /mcp/authorities/{id}/sender_constraint — configuration field
documents.summary: Optional named-authority DPoP sender proof. It is not available in the compact single-issuer form and needs bound access tokens and protected replay state.

documents.title: /mcp/authorities/{id}/sender_constraint/type — configuration field
documents.summary: Select dpop to require this authority’s bound access token and sender proof; it is not a generic bearer setting.

documents.title: /mcp/authorities/{id}/sender_constraint/proof_max_age_seconds — configuration field
documents.summary: Maximum accepted DPoP proof age, 1–300 seconds. Replayed or stale proofs must fail.

documents.title: /mcp/authorities/{id}/sender_constraint/clock_skew_seconds — configuration field
documents.summary: Accepted proof clock skew, 0–30 seconds and no greater than proof_max_age_seconds; omission defaults to zero.

documents.title: /mcp/authorities/{id}/sender_constraint/nonce — configuration field
documents.summary: Required resource nonce challenge for DPoP. Never log nonce/proof/access-token material.

documents.title: /mcp/authorities/{id}/sender_constraint/replay_store — configuration field
documents.summary: Select local_persistent protected nonce/replay state for one replica. Do not copy/reset state or assume multi-host coordination.

documents.title: /repository — configuration field
documents.summary: Signed release-source declaration. `sync` invokes its guarded `FetchCurrent` path; native, recovery, provider, and release qualification remain separate requirements.

documents.title: /repository/url — configuration field
documents.summary: Signed repository endpoint, no userinfo/query/fragment.

documents.title: /repository/directory — configuration field
documents.summary: Private local repository state directory.

documents.title: /repository/ref — configuration field
documents.summary: `refs/heads/...` or `refs/tags/...`; traversal, hidden, lock, and malformed components are rejected.

documents.title: /repository/allowed_signers_file — configuration field
documents.summary: Protected local SSH allowed-signers trust file, outside `directory`.

documents.title: /repository/initial_commit — configuration field
documents.summary: Immutable signed bootstrap commit.

documents.title: /repository/token_file — configuration field
documents.summary: Protected authenticated-fetch token; it is not needed to validate an accepted local release.

documents.title: /observability — configuration field
documents.summary: Optional bounded OTLP/HTTP metrics, traces and logs; omission opens no exporter connection and does not disable required security audit.

documents.title: /observability/enabled — configuration field
documents.summary: Explicitly enables selected operational signals. Disabling the whole object uses only enabled=false.

documents.title: /observability/service_name — configuration field
documents.summary: Non-sensitive service label for the exported operational signals, not an authentication identity.

documents.title: /observability/environment — configuration field
documents.summary: Deliberate non-sensitive environment label for telemetry; do not insert user or secret identifiers.

documents.title: /observability/diagnostic_level — configuration field
documents.summary: Select off/error/info/debug detail. Higher verbosity never permits secret values or raw errors.

documents.title: /observability/resource_attributes — configuration field
documents.summary: Only the declared non-sensitive service namespace/instance labels, not an arbitrary resource map.

documents.title: /observability/resource_attributes/service_namespace — configuration field
documents.summary: Non-sensitive team/service grouping label; not a tenant grant or personal identity.

documents.title: /observability/resource_attributes/service_instance_id — configuration field
documents.summary: Non-sensitive service-instance label; never embed a token, user identity or secret selector.

documents.title: /observability/metrics — configuration field
documents.summary: Explicit metrics signal declaration; when enabled it includes the collection interval.

documents.title: /observability/metrics/enabled — configuration field
documents.summary: Turns the metrics signal on or off. A disabled signal contains only enabled=false.

documents.title: /observability/metrics/interval_seconds — configuration field
documents.summary: Metric collection interval, 1–3600 seconds, required only for enabled metrics.

documents.title: /observability/traces — configuration field
documents.summary: Explicit traces signal declaration; when enabled it includes a sample ratio.

documents.title: /observability/traces/enabled — configuration field
documents.summary: Turns the traces signal on or off. A disabled signal contains only enabled=false.

documents.title: /observability/traces/sample_ratio — configuration field
documents.summary: Trace sampling fraction from 0 to 1, required for enabled traces.

documents.title: /observability/logs — configuration field
documents.summary: Explicit metadata-only log export declaration, separate from durable required audit.

documents.title: /observability/logs/enabled — configuration field
documents.summary: Turns approved metadata log export on or off; it never permits raw application/provider payloads.

documents.title: /observability/endpoint — configuration field
documents.summary: HTTPS collector origin. The client chooses fixed /v1/metrics, /v1/traces and /v1/logs paths; no arbitrary headers or ambient OTEL settings.

documents.title: /observability/token_file — configuration field
documents.summary: Protected collector-only bearer token file reference, never token bytes in configuration.

documents.title: /observability/trust_store_file — configuration field
documents.summary: Canonical protected CA-only PEM path replacing trust for this collector client only; configure its matching digest together.

documents.title: /observability/trust_store_sha256 — configuration field
documents.summary: Exact lowercase SHA256 of the collector CA bundle, paired with trust_store_file; this does not change host-wide trust.

documents.title: /observability/timeout_seconds — configuration field
documents.summary: Per-export timeout, 1–30 seconds, keeping collector failure finite.

documents.title: /observability/export_interval_seconds — configuration field
documents.summary: Export batching interval, 1–60 seconds.

documents.title: /observability/batch_size — configuration field
documents.summary: Maximum records per export batch, 1–512.

documents.title: /observability/queue_size — configuration field
documents.summary: Finite queued-record budget, 1–8192 and at least batch_size. Telemetry backpressure cannot authorize work or waive required audit.

documents.title: /updates — configuration field
documents.summary: Optional release-awareness/minimum-version declaration. No object means no feed connection; checks do not install software.

documents.title: /updates/check — configuration field
documents.summary: never disables feed checks; interactive permits bounded terminal notices without reading a response. Never mode cannot include channel/feed/timing fields.

documents.title: /updates/channel — configuration field
documents.summary: stable excludes prereleases; release-candidate includes eligible prerelease/stable versions under semantic ordering.

documents.title: /updates/interval_hours — configuration field
documents.summary: Minimum interval between configured checks, 1–720 hours; interactive policy specifies it explicitly.

documents.title: /updates/timeout_seconds — configuration field
documents.summary: Finite release-feed request timeout, 1–30 seconds.

documents.title: /updates/feed_endpoint — configuration field
documents.summary: Credential-free HTTPS feed endpoint with compatible metadata; redirects and ambient proxies are not accepted.

documents.title: /updates/token_file — configuration field
documents.summary: Protected release-feed credential file reference; never put credential bytes or URL userinfo in configuration.

documents.title: /updates/trust_store_file — configuration field
documents.summary: Protected CA bundle for the feed client, required together with its exact digest; not a host trust change.

documents.title: /updates/trust_store_sha256 — configuration field
documents.summary: 64 lowercase hex digest of the configured feed CA bundle, paired with trust_store_file.

documents.title: /updates/minimum_version — configuration field
documents.summary: Complete Semantic Version required locally before sensitive effects, independent of network/feed availability.

documents.title: /composition — configuration field
documents.summary: Root-owned, client-resolved master/include graph. It yields one fully validated policy without uploading personal configuration.

documents.title: /composition/includes — configuration field
documents.summary: Ordered 1–16 master-selected include descriptors; dependencies precede users and graph depth is bounded to eight.

documents.title: /composition/includes/* — configuration field
documents.summary: One master-selected pinned local/shared fragment. Fragments cannot add transitive downloads or privileged root settings.

documents.title: /composition/includes/*/id — configuration field
documents.summary: Unique lowercase include ID up to 24 characters; root is reserved.

documents.title: /composition/includes/*/namespace — configuration field
documents.summary: Unique lowercase namespace up to 24 characters; __ is reserved for qualification and combined IDs must fit 64 characters.

documents.title: /composition/includes/*/sha256 — configuration field
documents.summary: Required lowercase SHA256 of exact fragment bytes, reviewed through the trusted master.

documents.title: /composition/includes/*/file — configuration field
documents.summary: Protected local fragment within its declared base. Select local visibility; do not also specify repository/refresh fields.

documents.title: /composition/includes/*/repository — configuration field
documents.summary: Signed repository descriptor for a shared fragment, with separate local cache and explicit signing/bootstrap trust.

documents.title: /composition/includes/*/repository/url — configuration field
documents.summary: Signed repository endpoint, no userinfo/query/fragment.

documents.title: /composition/includes/*/repository/directory — configuration field
documents.summary: Private local repository state directory.

documents.title: /composition/includes/*/repository/ref — configuration field
documents.summary: `refs/heads/...` or `refs/tags/...`; traversal, hidden, lock, and malformed components are rejected.

documents.title: /composition/includes/*/repository/allowed_signers_file — configuration field
documents.summary: Protected local SSH allowed-signers trust file, outside `directory`.

documents.title: /composition/includes/*/repository/initial_commit — configuration field
documents.summary: Immutable signed bootstrap commit.

documents.title: /composition/includes/*/repository/token_file — configuration field
documents.summary: Protected authenticated-fetch token; it is not needed to validate an accepted local release.

documents.title: /composition/includes/*/path — configuration field
documents.summary: Repository-only safe relative fragment path; combine exact commit and byte digest verification.

documents.title: /composition/includes/*/commit — configuration field
documents.summary: Repository-only exact 40 lowercase hex commit; signature, ancestry, commit and file digest checks all apply.

documents.title: /composition/includes/*/base_directory — configuration field
documents.summary: Required client-local reference base, absolute or relative to the master. Child data/credential paths bind here independently of fragment storage.

documents.title: /composition/includes/*/depends_on — configuration field
documents.summary: Unique earlier include IDs whose namespaced sources this fragment can reference; no implicit root/sibling access.

documents.title: /composition/includes/*/depends_on/* — configuration field
documents.summary: One entry in this collection: Unique earlier include IDs whose namespaced sources this fragment can reference; no implicit root/sibling access.

documents.title: /composition/includes/*/visibility — configuration field
documents.summary: local keeps fragment references/private provenance within its custody domain; shared selects the signed repository route.

documents.title: /composition/includes/*/refresh — configuration field
documents.summary: Repository-only explicit online/offline policy. Online fetch/trust failure cannot silently choose an offline cache.

documents.title: /composition/includes/*/cache_expires_at — configuration field
documents.summary: Future RFC3339 deadline for admission of verified offline repository config. It is not a lifetime lease on a running consumer.

documents.title: /composition/conflicts — configuration field
documents.summary: Exactly reject: there is no implicit deep merge or last-writer override.

documents.title: /composition/overrides — configuration field
documents.summary: At most 128 root-owned property edits beneath existing sources/workloads; arrays are replaced whole rather than traversed.

documents.title: /composition/overrides/* — configuration field
documents.summary: One explicit root-owned pointer/value edit; it cannot let a fragment grant itself authority.

documents.title: /composition/overrides/*/pointer — configuration field
documents.summary: RFC6901 pointer to an allowed existing source/workload property; duplicate/overlapping override pointers deny.

documents.title: /composition/overrides/*/value — configuration field
documents.summary: Non-null JSON replacement value, validated after application as part of the complete policy.

documents.title: /composition/locks — configuration field
documents.summary: At most 128 final equality assertions. Missing/unequal values and duplicate/overlapping pointers deny.

documents.title: /composition/locks/* — configuration field
documents.summary: One final pointer/value equality assertion; it is a local constraint, not proof of a signed enterprise security profile.

documents.title: /composition/locks/*/pointer — configuration field
documents.summary: RFC6901 pointer whose final property must equal the asserted value; missing or unequal properties deny.

documents.title: /composition/locks/*/value — configuration field
documents.summary: Non-null expected final JSON value; assertion does not create or repair that value.
